remarks: Prepare to be impressed by this unique second-floor condo offering soaring ceilings, stylish updates, and a spacious loft that sets it apart! The dramatic great room feels bright, open, and exceptionally spacious, creating an inviting setting for both everyday living and entertaining. The beautifully updated kitchen features new cabinetry, quartz countertops, a convenient breakfast bar, and new stainless steel refrigerator, dishwasher, and stove—all included. New flooring and lighting add a fresh, modern feel throughout. Two generously sized bedrooms provide comfortable accommodations, while the large loft offers wonderful flexibility as a potential third bedroom, home office, den, or additional living space. Even more potential awaits with unfinished attic space accessed through the loft closet, offering the possibility for additional usable space. Enjoy your own private balcony overlooking peaceful green space and a wooded setting with no rear neighbors—a perfect spot to relax and unwind. Additional updates include a newer furnace, central air, and hot water tank, plus the washer and dryer are included for added convenience. Located in a charming, smaller condo development in a lovely area with plenty of open parking, this special property offers space, privacy, updates, and versatility that can be hard to find. A true gem and an opportunity you won't want to miss!
